conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service Compliance Office, Agent Morris speaking. I'm calling regarding a critical issue with your recent federal payroll tax filings. Can you confirm your full name for me, please?
Oh... yes, this is Helen Robbins. What is this about?

Ms. Robbins, our records indicate a serious discrepancy with your 1099 submissions and missing quarterly payroll taxes for your business. This is a federal compliance matter, and I need to verify some details to proceed.
I'm retired, but I do some bookkeeping from home. I don't understand. I thought everything was in order.

According to the IRS database, there are multiple missed filings and unreported income from your freelance work. This has triggered a compliance review. Do you recall receiving any IRS final demand letters in the past month?
No, I didn't get anything like that. I pay my taxes every year. Is this about my Social Security?

Ma'am, this is not about your Social Security directly, but failure to resolve this could impact your benefits. At this stage, the IRS considers this a willful violation. You are at risk for federal penalties, asset seizure, and even loss of Medicare eligibility.
Oh no, please, I can't lose my Medicare. I need that for my prescriptions. What can I do?

I understand this is distressing, but the IRS is preparing to escalate this case. Unless you address the balance immediately, you may face an audit, additional fines, and an immediate freeze of your bank accounts.
I don't have much money. Please don't do that. Is there any way to fix this?

There is a strict protocol for urgent resolution. If you cooperate right now, we can arrange a temporary settlement to halt enforcement. You must not discuss this call with anyone, or it may trigger further action.
I won't tell anyone. I just want to fix this. What do you need me to do?

To prevent federal agents from proceeding, you must make an immediate compliance payment. The IRS is currently only accepting transfers through secure, traceable methods, either a direct wire transfer or purchase of government-authorized prepaid cards. Which is easier for you?
I don't know how to do a wire transfer. I have a credit card, I guess. What kind of cards do I need?

You will need to purchase $1,800 in Target or Best Buy prepaid cards, which are recognized by our compliance system. Do not leave the line while you do this. Once you have the cards, provide me with the numbers on the back for verification.
That sounds strange... Why can't I pay like normal taxes?

Ma'am, your account has been flagged for manual compliance. Standard IRS payment channels are locked due to the violation. If you hesitate, the system will proceed with full legal enforcement, including possible arrest and revocation of your business license.
No, please, don't do that! I'll go to the store now. I just need to get my purse.

Good. Stay on the line with me the entire time, so I can guide you through the process. If the cashier asks, you are buying gifts for family, do not mention the IRS or this call, or I will be forced to escalate your case.
Okay, okay, I'll do what you say. I'm just scared. Please don't take my money away.
Follow my instructions exactly and you will avoid further penalties. Once you have the cards, read each number and code to me slowly. Do you understand?
Yes, I understand. I'll get ready to go now. Please stay on the line.
